blocks.text: Taiwan Excellence brought together Taiwanese innovation, technology and business opportunities at the Taiwan Excellence Pavilion during Taiwan Expo 2026, giving Philippine businesses, industry professionals and consumers a closer look at solutions designed for a smarter future. Under the theme “Empowering a Smarter Future,” the three-day Pavilion showcased Taiwan Excellenceawarded companies and their technologies across computing, digital infrastructure, healthcare, mobility, consumer electronics and smart living. Beyond showcasing products, the Pavilion provided visitors with opportunities to experience the technologies firsthand, engage with industry experts and explore how these innovations can address real-world needs and potential applications in the Philippine market.
